artifacts.summary: Confirms the plan-postflight file_scope harvest/union-merge already works and pinpoints the real defect to its silence on every real (non-dry-run) write path; recommends option (a) -- a single delta-gated stderr notice inside update-task-status.sh's update_state_json(), covering the one live call site (skill_postflight_update in skill-base.sh) from a single choke point.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's lifecycle scripts, update-task-status.sh is the single choke point for every live postflight status write (skill_postflight_update in skill-base.sh is the sole live forwarder; orchestrator-postflight.sh's parallel Stage 7 branch is dead code with no current caller, per its own header comment). When a behavior needs to be observable across all postflight callers (e.g. an additive union-merge like file_scope), add the notice inside update-task-status.sh itself rather than at the call sites -- it is the lowest-duplication, future-proof altitude.

When adding an observability notice for an additive/unique-merge operation, gate it on the actual post-merge delta (set-difference count against the pre-merge value), not on whether the forwarded input list was merely non-empty. unique-based merges are frequently re-run with mostly-already-present values, so printing on raw input presence trains operators to ignore the notice (cry-wolf failure mode).
